BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE ANAND PATHAK  ON THE 21 st OF APRIL, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 15147 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 MITENDRA CHOUDHARY S/O HARCHAT CHOUDHARY,
 AGED ABOUT 26 YEARS, OCCUPATION: BUSINESS R/O  MUKAS KHURD P.S. AND TEH.

NIWAS DISTRICT  MANDLA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI DURGESH SINGORE- ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION NIWAS DISTRICT MANDLA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI MOHAN SAUSARKAR- GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail has been filed on behalf of the applicant, who has been in judicial custody since 02.01.2023 in connection with Crime No.26/2023 registered at Police Station- Niwas, District-Mandla for the offence punishable under Section 376 and 323 of IPC.
2. It is the submission of the learned counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 02.01.2023 and charge-sheet has already been filed.
It is further submitted that story indicates improbable event because medical report belies the allegation.
As per allegation, the applicant forced himself over the prosecutrix in rough terrene but she did not sustain any injuries externally or internally.
FIR is delayed by two days that creates suspicion.
Only on the statements of prosecutrix and her sister, case has been registered and prosecutrix has not substantiated the case with the help of call detail report and other particulars.

Confinement amounts to pre-trial detention Mitendra Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46130016/
1 specially when the applicant does not bear any criminal record.

sentences.text: He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
The applicant shall not move in the vicinity of complainant and shall not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the complainant in any manner.
Therefore, he prayed for bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.

4. Considering the submission advanced by the counsel and medial report belies the allegation,
without commenting o n the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.

7. The applicant shall not move in the vicinity of prosecutrix and shall not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the prosecutrix, in any manner, otherwise benefit of bail shall be immediately withdrawn.
6. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance from the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE rk.
